items: 星期三（第一个 d 不发音）
a.title: 开场抽查：上周还没记住的词（6 个）

lesson: 英语句子像音乐，有强有弱。名词、动词、形容词、数字这些「实词」读得重、读得清楚；a、the、of、to、and、for 这些「虚词」读得又轻又快，元音常常变成 /ə/。中文每个字都一样重，所以这一点要专门练。
一张去伦敦的票。/ə ˈtɪkɪt tə ˈlʌndən/：重读 TICK 和 LON，a 和 to 一带而过。
一杯茶。/ə ˈkʌp əv ˈtiː/：听起来像 a cuppa tea。
The bus to the airport is late.
去机场的公交晚点了。重读 bus、airport、late；第二个 the 在元音前读 /ði/。
练法：用手指轻轻打拍子，只在实词上打，虚词挤在拍子中间快速带过。听写时虚词听不清很正常，用语法把它补上：a ticket、the bus、a cup of tea。
雅思听力最爱考 13 和 30、14 和 40 这样的数字。单独念时，-teen 重音在后，/iːn/ 拉得长；-ty 重音在前，尾巴很短。美音里 -ty 的 t 常常变成轻轻的 d：thirty 听起来像 thir-dy。
十三，三十。thir-TEEN（尾巴长）；THIR-ty（尾巴短）。
十四，四十。注意拼写：forty 没有 u（不是 fourty）。
The number forty bus leaves at ten fifteen.
四十路公交十点十五分开。
在句子里，-teen 后面紧跟名词时重音会往前跑（fourteen minutes），所以最稳的办法是听尾巴：/iːn/ 长而清楚就是十几。听写里的数字一律写英文单词，拼写也要对：fifteen（不是 fiveteen）、eighteen（只有一个 t）、ninety（保留 e）。
quiz: 在 a cup of tea 里，of 通常读成？
of 是虚词，在句子里弱读成 /əv/，说得快时只剩 /ə/。
The bus to the airport is late. 这句话里读得最重的是哪几个词？
名词 bus、airport 和形容词 late 是实词，要重读；the、to、is 是虚词，弱读。
听写时听到 /ə ˈkʌp əv ˈkɑːfi/，应该写成？
/ə/ 是 a，/əv/ 是 of。cup 和 coffee 之间一定有 of。
单独念的时候，哪个数字的重音在后面？
-teen 结尾的数字重音在后：four-TEEN；-ty 结尾的重音在前：FOR-ty。
听到 thir-dy（重音在前、尾巴很短），是哪个数字？
重音在前、尾巴短，是 thirty（30）。美音里 -ty 的 t 常常变成轻轻的 d。
a.title: 发音和听力：句子有强有弱；十几还是几十
单词：交通出行（25 个）
words: n. 地铁（英式；美式说 subway）
n. 车站（bus stop 公交站）v. 停
n. 交通；路上的车（不可数）
v. 乘坐（车）；花（时间）（过去式 took）
v. 赶上（车）（过去式 caught）
v. 离开；（车）出发（过去式 left）

lesson: 中文说「某处有某物」，英语用 There is / There are。用 is 还是 are，看后面的东西是一个还是多个。
There is a bus stop near my home.（我家附近有一个公交站。）
There are three trains every hour.（每小时有三趟火车。）
There is + 不可数的东西
There is a lot of traffic today.（今天路上车很多。）
There are two stations in our town.
我们镇上有两个火车站。
否定：在 is / are 后面加 not。疑问：把 is / are 放到 there 前面。问「有没有」常用 any。
There isn't a train on Sunday.
周日没有火车。isn't = is not。
Is there a bus to the airport? — Yes, there is.
Are there any taxis at the station? — No, there aren't.
别用 have 说「某处有」：「我家附近有一个公园」是 There is a park near my home.，不说 My home has a park near.。口语里 There is 常缩成 There's。
quiz: There ___ a bus stop near my flat.
a bus stop 是一个，用 is。
我的公寓附近有一个公交站。
three trains 是复数，用 are。
a taxi 是单数；疑问句把 Is 放到句首。
There is a lot of ___ today.
traffic 不可数，没有复数，所以用 There is。说 cars 要用 There are a lot of cars。
「我家附近有一个公园。」怎么说？
My home has a park near.
There is a park near my home.
I have a park near my home.
表示某地「有」某物，用 There is。
意思变成「我拥有一个公园」
Are there any buses at night? — No, there ___.
问句用 Are there，回答也用 are：No, there aren't。
a.title: 语法：There is / There are（某处有某物）

items: The train leaves at ten fifteen.
There are three trains every hour.
The next train is on platform nineteen.
下一趟火车在十九号站台。
A ticket to the airport is sixteen pounds.
去机场的票是十六英镑。
b.title: 听力专项：时间和十几、几十（6 句）

parse: There is a train station in the town centre, and there are four trains to London every hour.
两个 there be 句子用 and 连起来：There is a train station + there are four trains。is 配单数 a station，are 配复数 four trains。
镇中心有一个火车站，每小时有四趟火车去伦敦。
She never drives to work, because there is a lot of traffic in the morning.
主干 She never drives to work；because 引出原因：there is a lot of traffic。traffic 不可数，所以用 is。
她从不开车上班，因为早上路上车很多。
quiz: How long is the train journey to London?
原文：The journey takes fifty minutes。fifty（五十）重音在前。
Which bus goes to the airport?
原文：The number fourteen bus goes to the airport。
How many trains go to London in two hours?
每小时四趟（four trains every hour），两小时就是八趟。这种题要自己算一下。
两小时里有几趟火车去伦敦？
passage.text: Maple Bridge is a small town, but it is easy to get around. There is a train station in the town centre, and there are four trains to London every hour. The journey takes fifty minutes. There are also two bus stations. The number fourteen bus goes to the airport, and a ticket is three pounds forty. Lily works in London, so she takes the train from Monday to Friday. She never drives to work, because there is a lot of traffic in the morning. Is there a bus at night? Yes, there is one every hour, but there isn't a train after midnight.
passage.title: Getting Around Maple Bridge
passage.zh: 枫桥是个小镇，但出行很方便。镇中心有一个火车站，每小时有四趟火车去伦敦，路上要五十分钟。镇上还有两个公交车站。14 路公交车去机场，票价 3 英镑 40 便士。Lily 在伦敦上班，所以她周一到周五都坐火车。她从不开车上班，因为早上路上车很多。晚上有公交吗？有，每小时一趟，但午夜以后就没有火车了。

b.title: 阅读：Getting Around Maple Bridge（在枫桥出行）
听辨游戏：fourteen 还是 forty？（十四还是四十）
单词第二遍：卡片自测（也可以选「听写」）

items: 我家附近有一个公交站。
There is a bus stop near my home.
There are two trains every hour.
There is a lot of traffic this morning.
Are there any taxis at the station?
I usually take the train to work.
c.title: 写 5 句话

speak.model: I usually take the MRT, because it is fast and cheap. There is a station near my home, so it is very convenient. Sometimes I take a bus, but there is a lot of traffic in the evening. I don't drive, because parking is expensive in Singapore.
speak.modelZh: 我通常坐地铁（新加坡叫 MRT），因为又快又便宜。我家附近就有一个站，所以很方便。有时候我坐公交，但晚上路上车很多。我不开车，因为在新加坡停车很贵。
phrases: I usually take the …, because …
我通常坐……，因为……
There is a … near my home, so it is very convenient.
我家附近有……，所以很方便。
There is a lot of traffic in the evening.
晚上路上车很多。
speak.q: How do you usually get around your city?
speak.tip: 坐交通工具用 take：take the train、take a bus、take a taxi；开车用 drive，骑车用 ride a bike。回答里用上今天的 There is …，再加一个原因（because …）。
speak.zh: 你在城里通常怎么出行？

c.title: 口语：你在城里通常怎么出行？

days.teacher: 第 2 周开始啦！这一周每天上午先做 10 分钟「开场抽查」，把前一天的词句听写一遍（今天抽的是上周还没记住的词），再学新课。新课有三条线：连读和弱读（帮你听清小词）、150 个生活词、there be 和一般过去时等语法。听写是你最想提高的，这周每天练两次：先慢速，一个词一个词地写。

Is there a discount for students?

a.title: 开场抽查：昨天的词句和上周的难词（6 个）

lesson: 前一个词以辅音结尾、后一个词以元音开头时，两个词要连起来读，像一个词。这是英语听起来「连成一片」的主要原因。
我能帮你吗？can 的 n 连到 I 上：ca-nI help you。
多少钱？much 的 ch 连到 is，is 的 s 连到 it：how mu-chi-zit。
我可以试穿吗？try it on 连成 try-i-ton；美音里 t 夹在两个元音中间，读得像轻轻的 d：try-i-don。
一双鞋。美音 pair 结尾的 r 连到 of 上：a pai-rof shoes。
听写时如果听到一个「不认识的长词」，先想一想：是不是两三个小词连在一起了？比如 mu-chi-zit 其实是 much is it。写的时候要分开写。
twelve pounds fifty，或者 twelve fifty
fifty p（p 是便士 pence 的简称）
five ninety-nine，或者 five dollars ninety-nine
two hundred and fifty pounds（美式常省略 and）
The total is two hundred and fifty pounds.
听写里写英文单词：21 到 99 的两位数中间要加连字符，twenty-one、forty-five、ninety-nine。hundred 后面的 and 读得很轻（/ən/），别漏写。
quiz: How much is it? 连读后听起来像？
how / much / is / it，一个词一个词断开
much 的 ch 连到 is，is 的 s 连到 it。
下面哪一组是「辅音 + 元音」，要连起来读？
an 以辅音 n 结尾，egg 以元音开头，连成 a-negg。
听到 ca-nI-try-i-ton，写下来应该是？
连读把 can 和 I、it 和 on 连在一起，写的时候要分开。
价钱读成 twelve pounds fifty，也可以简单说 twelve fifty。
听到 two hundred and fifty，写成数字是？
a.title: 发音和听力：连读①（辅音 + 元音）；价钱怎么听
单词：购物（25 个）
words: n. 商店 v. 购物（美式常说 store）
v. 花（钱、时间）（过去式 spent）
n. 零钱；找的钱 v. 改变
n. 收据；小票（p 不发音）
n. 鞋（复数；一双鞋 a pair of shoes）
n. 颜色（美式拼写 color）
n. 促销；减价（on sale 在打折）
n. 队伍 v. 排队（英式；美式说 line）
v. 开门 adj. 营业的；开着的

lesson: 代词用来代替名词，免得一直重复。放在动词前面做主语，用主格；放在动词或介词（with、for、to……）后面，用宾格。
I like this jacket. Can I try it on?
我喜欢这件夹克。我可以试穿吗？it 代替 this jacket。
These shoes are nice. How much are they?
这双鞋真好看。多少钱？they 代替 these shoes。
My sister likes shopping. I often go with her.
我姐姐喜欢购物，我经常和她一起去。with 是介词，后面用 her。
你能帮帮我吗？help 是动词，后面用 me。
三个提醒：① I 永远大写，哪怕在句子中间，不要用小写 l 代替。② 说男的用 he / him，说女的用 she / her，别混。③ try on 的宾语是代词时，代词放中间：try it on，不说 try on it。
quiz: This jacket is nice. Can I try ___ on?
jacket 是一件东西，用 it；代词放在 try 和 on 中间。
这件夹克真好看。我可以试穿吗？
These shoes are cheap. I want to buy ___.
shoes 是复数，放在动词 buy 后面，用宾格 them。
___ is my brother. He works in a shop.
放在句首做主语，用主格 He。
他是我哥哥。他在一家商店工作。
My mother likes markets. I often go shopping with ___.
with 是介词，后面用宾格 her。
我妈妈喜欢逛市场。我经常和她一起去购物。
help 是动词，后面用宾格 me。
Tom and Anna are customers. ___ want a receipt.
放在动词 want 前面做主语，用主格 They。
Tom 和 Anna 是顾客。他们想要一张小票。
a.title: 语法：人称代词：I 和 me，he 和 him

items: This shirt is twelve pounds fifty.
这件衬衫十二英镑五十便士。
The shoes are on sale for thirty pounds.
这双鞋打折，只要三十英镑。
The total is two hundred and fifty pounds.
Here is your change and your receipt.
这是找您的零钱和小票。
b.title: 听力专项：价钱（6 句）

parse: The shop assistant gives her a size ten, but it is too small for her.
主干 The shop assistant gives her a size ten（给谁 her，给什么 a size ten）；but 后面：it is too small。it 指那件 10 码的夹克。
店员给她拿了一件 10 码的，但对她来说太小了。
The jacket is usually sixty pounds, but today it is on sale for forty-five pounds.
两个句子用 but 连起来：The jacket is sixty pounds + it is on sale。for forty-five pounds 说打折后的价钱。
这件夹克平时卖六十英镑，但今天打折，只要四十五英镑。
quiz: Why does Anna go to the shopping centre?
原文第一句：Anna needs a new jacket。
Anna 为什么去购物中心？
How much does Anna pay for the jacket?
平时 sixty pounds，今天打折，只要 forty-five pounds。原价是干扰项，雅思很爱这样出题。
Anna 买这件夹克付了多少钱？
In 'I don't need them', what does 'them' mean?
them 代替前面说的 the shoes。找代词指什么，就往前找最近的复数名词。
I don't need them 里的 them 指什么？
passage.text: Anna needs a new jacket for the winter, so she goes to the shopping centre on King Street with her friend Ben. There is a big sale in one of the shops. Anna likes a black jacket. 'Can I try it on?' she asks. The shop assistant gives her a size ten, but it is too small for her. She tries a size twelve, and it fits. The jacket is usually sixty pounds, but today it is on sale for forty-five pounds. Ben likes the shoes in the shop, but he doesn't buy them. 'They are nice, but I don't need them,' he says. Anna pays by card, and the assistant gives her the receipt.
passage.title: A New Jacket
passage.zh: Anna 冬天需要一件新夹克，所以她和朋友 Ben 去了国王街的购物中心。其中一家店在大促销。Anna 喜欢一件黑色的夹克。「我可以试穿吗？」她问。店员给她拿了一件 10 码的，但对她来说太小了。她又试了 12 码，正合身。这件夹克平时卖六十英镑，今天打折只要四十五英镑。Ben 喜欢店里的鞋，但他没买。「鞋很好看，但我不需要。」他说。Anna 刷卡付款，店员把小票给了她。

b.title: 阅读：A New Jacket（一件新夹克）
听辨游戏：sale 还是 sell？（促销还是卖）
单词第二遍：卡片自测（也可以选「听写」）

items: 我可以试穿一下吗？（说的是一件夹克）
我姐姐喜欢购物，我经常和她一起去。
My sister likes shopping. I often go with her.
The supermarket is closed on Sundays.
c.title: 写 5 句话

speak.model: I usually go to a shopping centre near my home. It is big, and there are lots of shops in it. I often buy clothes there, especially when there is a sale. Sometimes I shop online, because it is easy and I can do it at home.
speak.modelZh: 我通常去家附近的一个购物中心。它很大，里面有很多商店。我经常在那里买衣服，尤其是打折的时候。有时候我网购，因为很方便，在家就能买。
phrases: I usually go to …
我通常去……
There are lots of shops in it.
里面有很多商店。
especially when there is a sale
尤其是打折的时候
speak.q: Where do you usually go shopping?
speak.tip: 注意代词：it 指前面说过的 shopping centre，不要每句都重复名词。录完听一听，I、it 和词尾的辅音有没有读清楚。

c.title: 口语：你通常去哪里购物？

a.title: 开场抽查：昨天的词句和上周的难词（6 个）

lesson: 点餐时最常用的几个小词，在句子里都读得很轻。听不出来就会漏写；自己读得太重，听起来就不自然。
Can I have a coffee, please?
请给我一杯咖啡好吗？can 读成轻轻的 /kən/，重音在 have 和 coffee 上。
What would you like to drink?
你想喝点什么？would you 连成 /wʊdʒə/。
我想要点水。some 读得很轻：/səm/。
美音里，句子中的 can 弱读成很轻的 /kən/；can't 不弱读，元音 /æ/ 响亮、饱满，结尾的 t 很轻，有时几乎听不见。所以分辨 can't，主要听那个响亮的 /æ/。英音的 can't 读 /kɑːnt/，元音和 can 不一样。
我能吃辣。can 很轻：/aɪ kən ˈiːt/。
我不能吃辣。can't 很重：/aɪ ˈkænt ˈiːt/。写的时候别忘了撇号。
日期用序数词（第几）：first、second、third、fourth、fifth……英式常说 the third of May，美式常说 May third。
The restaurant opens on the first of June.
这家餐馆六月一日开业。
听写日期时把 the 和 of 也写上：the twelfth of October。of 在这里读得很轻（/əv/），最容易漏。
quiz: I can swim. 美音里 can 通常读成？
肯定句里的 can 弱读成 /kən/。
听到 /aɪ ˈkænt/，/æ/ 读得很重、很清楚，说的是？
can't 不弱读，元音 /æ/ 饱满、重读；can 在句子里很轻。
What would you like? 里 would you 连读后听起来像？
d 碰上 y 变成 /dʒ/：/wʊdʒə/。
the ninth of March 里 ninth 的拼写，哪个对？
nine 变成序数词要去掉 e：ninth。
听到 the twelfth of October，是哪一天？
twelfth 是第十二，October 是十月：10 月 12 日。
a.title: 发音和听力：点餐时的弱读；can 还是 can't；日期
单词：饮食（25 个）
words: v. 喝 n. 饮料（过去式 drank）

lesson: 表示「谁的」有两套：一套后面必须跟名词，一套单独用，后面不跟名词。
This is my coffee. That tea is yours.
这是我的咖啡。那杯茶是你的。
Is this your bag? — No, it's hers.
这是你的包吗？——不是，是她的。
指示代词：近处用 this（一个）/ these（多个），远处用 that（一个）/ those（多个）。
这些面条很好吃。noodles 是复数，所以用 these 和 are。
Can I have that cake, please?
its 和 it's 不一样：its = 它的（The café is small, but its food is good.）；it's = it is。its 没有撇号。
quiz: 后面有名词 bag，用 your。
后面没有名词，用单独用的 hers。
这杯咖啡不是我的，是她的。
noodles 是复数，近处用 These。
over there（在那边）是远处，一个用 that。
后面有名词 kitchen，用 our。
我们很喜欢我们的新厨房。
The restaurant is small, but ___ food is delicious.
表示「它的」用 its，没有撇号；it's = it is。
这家餐馆很小，但它的菜很好吃。
a.title: 语法：物主代词（my / mine）和 this / that

items: The new restaurant opens on the third of May.
这家新餐馆五月三日开业。
My birthday is on the twelfth of October.
我的生日是十月十二日。
The supermarket is closed on the twenty-fifth of December.
这家超市十二月二十五日不营业。
Can I have a cup of tea, please?
b.title: 听力专项：日期和点餐（6 句）

parse: It is small, but its food is delicious.
两个句子用 but 连起来：It is small + its food is delicious。its 是「它的」，指咖啡馆的，没有撇号。
店很小，但它的菜很好吃。
Lily pays for her meal, and Mia pays for hers.
两个句子用 and 连起来。her 后面有名词 meal；hers 后面没有名词，hers = her meal。
Lily 付她自己那顿饭的钱，Mia 付她自己的。
quiz: How much is the chicken soup?
原文：chicken soup for four pounds fifty，4 英镑 50 便士。
Mia 点了汤（4.50）和沙拉（5），一共 9.50 英镑。她付的是她自己那份（hers）。
原文：Leo works there, and every morning he writes the menu。
passage.text: Moon Café is on Park Street. It is small, but its food is delicious. Leo works there, and every morning he writes the menu on a board. It is Saturday today. On the menu, there is chicken soup for four pounds fifty, fish and rice for seven pounds, and a vegetable salad for five pounds. At one o'clock, Lily and her friend Mia come in. They are very hungry. 'Is this table free?' asks Lily. 'Yes, it is,' says Leo. Lily orders the fish, and Mia orders the soup and a salad. 'These vegetables are really fresh,' says Mia. After lunch, they ask for the bill. Lily pays for her meal, and Mia pays for hers.
passage.title: Lunch at Moon Café
passage.zh: 月光咖啡馆在公园街上。店很小，但菜很好吃。Leo 在那里工作，每天早上他都把菜单写在一块板子上。今天是星期六。菜单上有鸡汤，4 英镑 50 便士；鱼配米饭，7 英镑；蔬菜沙拉，5 英镑。一点钟，Lily 和她的朋友 Mia 走了进来，她们很饿。「这张桌子空着吗？」Lily 问。「是的，空着。」Leo 说。Lily 点了鱼，Mia 点了汤和一份沙拉。「这些蔬菜真新鲜。」Mia 说。吃完午饭，她们叫来账单。Lily 付她自己那顿饭的钱，Mia 付她自己的。

b.title: 阅读：Lunch at Moon Café（在月光咖啡馆吃午饭）

speak.model: My favourite food is chicken rice. It is a famous dish in Singapore. The chicken is soft and the rice is really delicious. I usually have it for lunch at a food court near my home. It is cheap, only about five dollars.
speak.modelZh: 我最喜欢的食物是鸡饭，它是新加坡的一道名菜。鸡肉很嫩，米饭特别好吃。我通常在家附近的美食广场吃它当午饭，很便宜，只要五块钱左右。

a.title: 开场抽查：昨天的词句和上周的难词（6 个）

lesson: 两个词中间是辅音碰辅音时，有两条规律：
① 相同的辅音只读一次，稍微拖长一点
bus stop → bu-stop；hot tea → ho-tea；cold day → col-day
② t、d 碰到另一个辅音，只做口型、不出声
last night → las(t) night；hot day → ho(t) day；cold weather → col(d) weather
那天很热。hot 的 t 碰到 day 的 d，只做口型：ho(t) day。
昨晚很冷。cold 的 d 和 last 的 t 都很轻：col(d) las(t) night。
was 和 were 的弱读
was 在句子中间读 /wəz/，were 读 /wə/（美音 /wɚ/），又轻又快。只有放在句尾或者强调时，才读强音 /wɒz/（美音 /wʌz/）和 /wɜː/（美音 /wɝː/）。
Were you at home? — Yes, I was.
你在家吗？——在。第一个 were 很轻；句尾的 was 读强音。
听写时，t、d 读得再轻，拼写也一个字母都不能少：last night、cold day。was、were 很轻，但句子里有 yesterday、last week，就要想到它们。
quiz: bus stop 怎么读最自然？
bus 和 stop 中间停一下
相同的辅音只读一次，稍微拖长。
It was sunny. 里 was 通常读成？
was 在句子中间弱读成 /wəz/。
听写：听到 It was col las night，写下来应该是？
d、t 只是读得轻，拼写时不能丢：cold、last。was 也不能漏。
Were you tired? — Yes, I was. 句尾的 was 怎么读？
放在句尾的 was 要读强音。
听到 minus five degrees，气温是？
minus 是「零下；减」：minus five degrees = -5°C。

adj. 冷的 n. 感冒（have a cold）

n. 秋天（美式常说 fall）

lesson: 说过去的事（yesterday 昨天、last week 上周、two days ago 两天前），be 动词要变成过去式：am、is 变成 was，are 变成 were。
We were at home last weekend because it was rainy.
上周末下雨，所以我们在家。
否定：was not = wasn't，were not = weren't。疑问：把 was / were 放到句首。
Were you tired yesterday? — Yes, I was.
there be 的过去式是 There was / There were。
There was a big storm last night.
时间词通常放在句尾：yesterday、last night、last week、two days ago。注意 last week、last night 前面不加 in 或 on。
quiz: yesterday 是过去，it 用 was。
We ___ at the beach last Sunday.
___ it cold in London last week?
it 用 was；疑问句把 Was 放到句首。
two storms 是复数，用 There were。
The weather ___ good yesterday, so we stayed at home.
weather 不可数，当单数用，所以用 wasn't。
昨天天气不好，所以我们待在家里。

items: It was very cold last night.
The temperature was minus five degrees.
There was a big storm on the eighth of January.
一月八日有一场大暴风雨。

因为下雨，我们待在家里。

b.title: 听力专项：温度和天气（6 句）

gloss: at home with a good book
parse: On Tuesday and Wednesday, it was rainy and windy, and there was a big storm on Wednesday night.
两个句子用 and 连起来：it was rainy and windy + there was a big storm。时间放在句首和句尾。was 是过去式。
周二和周三又下雨又刮风，周三晚上还有一场大暴风雨。
On Saturday, it was sunny and warm, about fifteen degrees, so Lily and her friends were in the park all afternoon.
主干 it was sunny and warm；about fifteen degrees 补充说明温度；so 引出结果：Lily and her friends were in the park。主语是复数，所以用 were。
周六天气晴朗暖和，大约十五度，所以 Lily 和朋友们在公园待了一下午。
quiz: What was the temperature on Monday?
原文：The temperature was only four degrees。15 度是周六。
原文：there was a big storm on Wednesday night。
Why were Lily and her friends in the park on Saturday?
Because it was sunny and warm
原文用 so 连起来：it was sunny and warm … so Lily and her friends were in the park。so 前面是原因，后面是结果。
Lily 和朋友们周六为什么在公园？
passage.text: Last week, the weather in Maple Bridge was terrible. On Monday, it was cloudy and very cold. The temperature was only four degrees. On Tuesday and Wednesday, it was rainy and windy, and there was a big storm on Wednesday night. Lily was at home with a good book. On Thursday morning, the streets were wet and the buses were late. But the weekend was great! On Saturday, it was sunny and warm, about fifteen degrees, so Lily and her friends were in the park all afternoon. Lily says, 'The weather here changes every day, so my umbrella is always in my bag!'
passage.title: A Wet Week
passage.zh: 上周枫桥的天气很糟糕。周一多云，非常冷，气温只有四度。周二和周三又下雨又刮风，周三晚上还有一场大暴风雨。Lily 待在家里看一本好书。周四早上，街道湿漉漉的，公交车都晚点了。但周末很棒！周六天气晴朗暖和，大约十五度，所以 Lily 和朋友们在公园待了一下午。Lily 说：「这里的天气每天都在变，所以我的包里总放着雨伞！」

b.title: 阅读：A Wet Week（下雨的一周）

c.title: 写 5 句话

speak.model: In Singapore, it is hot and humid all year. The temperature is usually about thirty degrees. It often rains in the afternoon, so I always take an umbrella. Last week, there was a big storm, and it was very windy. I like cool weather, so I love air-conditioned places!
speak.modelZh: 新加坡一年到头都又热又潮湿，气温通常在三十度左右。下午经常下雨，所以我总是带着伞。上周有一场大暴风雨，风特别大。我喜欢凉爽的天气，所以特别喜欢有空调的地方！
phrases: It is hot and humid all year.
一年到头都又热又潮湿。
It often rains in the afternoon.
下午经常下雨。
Last week, there was a big storm.
上周有一场大暴风雨。
speak.q: What's the weather like where you live?
speak.tip: 平时的天气用一般现在时（It often rains），说过去某一天的天气用 was（It was very windy）。加一句过去的经历，回答马上就生动了。

lesson: 过去式的 -ed 有三种读音。读错或者吞掉，别人就听不出你在说过去。
前面是 t 或 d
我咳了一整夜。coughed 只有一个音节，-ed 读 /t/：/kɑːft/。
她卧床休息。stayed 的 /d/ 连到 in 上：stay-din bed。
他需要休息。needed 有两个音节：nee-did，再连到 a 上。
自己读时先把 -ed 读清楚，甚至夸张一点。听的时候，句子里有 yesterday、last week，就要想到动词后面应该有 -ed。
雅思听力第一部分常常要你写下拼出来的名字。按元音把 26 个字母分组记，最不容易混：
B C D E G P T V（美音的 Z 读 zee）
F L M N S X（英音的 Z 读 zed）
G 读 /dʒiː/，J 读 /dʒeɪ/，这两个也很容易听混。
Bell. That is B, E, double L.
Bell，拼法是 B、E、两个 L。听到 double L 就写 LL。
这周的听写里，拼出来的名字直接写成一个词就行：听到 G-R-E-E-N，写 Green 或 G-R-E-E-N 都算对。年份两位两位地读：1995 = nineteen ninety-five。
quiz: stay 以元音结尾，-ed 读 /d/：/steɪd/。
d 结尾的动词加 -ed 读 /ɪd/，多出一个音节：nee-ded。
听到 W, double O, D，名字怎么写？
double O 就是两个 O：W-O-O-D，Wood。

lesson: 大部分动词变过去式，在词尾加 -ed。不管主语是谁都一样：过去式没有第三人称单数的 -s。
我昨天给医生打了电话。
She stayed in bed last Monday.
辅音 + y 结尾，y 变 i 再加 -ed
元音 + y 结尾，直接加 -ed
一个元音 + 一个辅音结尾的短词，双写最后的辅音
The bus stopped outside the hospital.
公交车停在了医院外面。
句子里有 yesterday、last night、last Monday、two days ago，动词就要用过去式。读的时候，词尾的 -ed 一定要读出来。
quiz: yesterday 是过去，用过去式 called。
我昨天给医生打了电话。
She ___ in bed all day last Monday.
stay 是元音 + y，直接加 -ed：stayed。
上周一她在床上躺了一整天。
He ___ English for two hours last night.
辅音 + y：y 变 i 再加 -ed，studied。
他昨晚学了两个小时英语。
The bus ___ outside the hospital yesterday.
昨天公交车停在了医院外面。
We ___ for the doctor for twenty minutes.
wait 的 t 前面有两个元音字母，不双写，直接加 -ed：waited。
我们等医生等了二十分钟。
The nurse ___ my temperature this morning.
一般直接加 -ed：checked（-ed 读 /t/，但拼写还是 -ed）。
今天早上护士给我量了体温。

我叫 Grace Hill，拼法是 H-I-L-L。
I would like to make an appointment.

我的出生日期是一九九五年四月四日。
Your doctor is Doctor Patel. That is P-A-T-E-L.

b.title: 听力专项：拼名字、出生日期和预约（6 句）

parse: At eight o'clock, he called Park Street Health Centre and asked for an appointment.
一个主语 he，两个过去式动词 called 和 asked，用 and 连起来。At eight o'clock 说时间。
八点钟，他给公园街健康中心打电话，要了一个预约。
The receptionist needed his name, so he spelled it: B-E-N W-A-R-D.
The receptionist needed his name + so + he spelled it。it 指 his name；冒号后面是拼出来的字母。
接待员需要他的名字，所以他拼了出来：B-E-N W-A-R-D。
quiz: What was Ben's temperature on Monday morning?
原文：his temperature was thirty-nine degrees。
周一早上 Ben 的体温是多少？
How long did Ben wait at the health centre?
原文：waited for twenty minutes。twenty 和 twelve 别听混。
Ben 在健康中心等了多久？
原文拼的是 B-E-N W-A-R-D：名 Ben 在前，姓 Ward 在后。
passage.text: Last Monday, Ben was ill. He coughed all night, and in the morning his temperature was thirty-nine degrees. At eight o'clock, he called Park Street Health Centre and asked for an appointment. The receptionist needed his name, so he spelled it: B-E-N W-A-R-D. Ben walked to the health centre and waited for twenty minutes. Mia, the nurse, checked his temperature. Then the doctor looked at his throat. 'You need some medicine and a lot of rest,' she explained. Ben stayed in bed for three days. On Friday, he was much better.
passage.title: A Visit to the Health Centre
passage.zh: 上周一，Ben 病了。他咳了一整夜，早上体温三十九度。八点钟，他给公园街健康中心打电话，要了一个预约。接待员需要他的名字，所以他拼了出来：B-E-N W-A-R-D。Ben 走路去了健康中心，等了二十分钟。护士 Mia 给他量了体温，然后医生看了看他的喉咙。「你需要吃点药，好好休息。」医生解释说。Ben 在床上躺了三天。到了周五，他好多了。

b.title: 阅读：A Visit to the Health Centre（去健康中心看病）

a.title: 开场抽查：昨天的词句（6 个）

lesson: 前一个词以元音结尾、后一个词也以元音开头时，中间会自然带出一个很轻的过渡音：
I agree → I-(y)agree；see it → see-(y)it；play a game → play-(y)a game
go out → go-(w)out；do it → do-(w)it；how about → how-(w)about
Do you want to go out tonight?
你今晚想出去吗？go out 中间带出一个轻轻的 /w/：go-wout。
你做什么运动吗？play a 中间带出 /j/：play-ya sport。
代词 him、her、them 在句子里不重读，h 常常不发音，和前面的词连在一起：
我昨天给他打了电话。called him 听起来像 call-dim。
告诉她时间。tell her 听起来像 tel-ler（美音 /ˈtelɚ/）。
我爱他们。love them 听起来像 lov-əm。
电话号码一个数字一个数字地读；0 读 oh（也可以读 zero）；两个相同的数字连在一起常说 double：55 = double five。
My number is oh seven nine, double four, six two.
这周的听写请照读音写单词：oh nine one double six。真正考试时写成数字就行（09166）。
quiz: go out 连读时，中间带出的过渡音是？
go 以 /oʊ/ 结尾，嘴唇是圆的，自然带出 /w/：go-wout。
I agree. 连读时，中间带出的过渡音是？
I /aɪ/ 以 /ɪ/ 收尾，自然带出 /j/：I-yagree。
听到 I call-dim yesterday，应该写成？
called 的 /d/ 连到 him，him 的 h 不发音：call-dim。
听到 double five，写成数字是？
0 在电话号码里常读 oh（和字母 O 一样），也可以读 zero。

adj. 感兴趣的（be interested in …）
adj. 令人兴奋的；精彩的

lesson: 有些常用动词的过去式不加 -ed，要单独记。先记下面这 14 个：
Last weekend I went swimming with my friends.
上周末我和朋友们去游泳了。
We saw a great film on Saturday.
我们周六看了一部很棒的电影。
否定和疑问用 didn't / Did，后面的动词一律用原形，规则、不规则都一样。
I didn't go out last night.
Did you play the piano yesterday? — No, I didn't.
你昨天弹钢琴了吗？——没有。
What did you do last weekend?
用了 did 或 didn't，后面就不能再用过去式：Did you went? ✗ → Did you go? ✓。这和 does / doesn't 后面用原形是一个道理。
quiz: Last Saturday we ___ to the cinema.
go 的过去式是不规则的 went。
上周六我们去了电影院。
I ___ a new guitar last month.
我上个月买了一把新吉他。
你看那场足球比赛了吗？
___ you swim in the sea last summer? — Yes, I did.
last summer 是过去，回答是 I did，所以用 Did。
你去年夏天在海里游泳了吗？——游了。
did 后面用原形 do：What did you do?
a.title: 语法：一般过去时（3）：不规则动词，did 和 didn't

items: I joined a swimming club last month.
我上个月加入了一个游泳俱乐部。
The club meets every Friday at seven thirty.
俱乐部每周五七点半活动。
My phone number is oh nine one double six.
I live at fifteen King Street.
We went to the cinema and saw a film.
我们去电影院看了一部电影。
Did you go swimming last weekend?
b.title: 听力专项：电话号码、地址和过去的事（6 句）

gloss: 起床了（get up 的过去式）
parse: Last Saturday, he got up late and went swimming with his friend Ben.
一个主语 he，两个不规则过去式 got up（get up）和 went（go），用 and 连起来。
上周六，他起得很晚，然后和朋友 Ben 去游泳了。
He joined a music club last year, and now he plays in a small band.
前半句说过去（joined，last year），后半句说现在（now，plays）。时间词决定用什么时态。
他去年加入了一个音乐俱乐部，现在在一个小乐队里演奏。
quiz: What did Sam do on Saturday morning?
原文：he got up late and went swimming with his friend Ben。弹吉他是下午，看电影是晚上。
Sam 周六上午做了什么？
Who did Sam see a film with?
原文：he saw a film with his colleagues。
Sam 和谁一起看了电影？
Did Sam go out on Sunday?
原文：On Sunday, he didn't go out。
passage.text: Sam is very busy from Monday to Friday, so his weekends are important to him. Last Saturday, he got up late and went swimming with his friend Ben. After that, they had lunch at Moon Café. In the afternoon, Sam played the guitar for an hour. He joined a music club last year, and now he plays in a small band. In the evening, he saw a film with his colleagues. It was really exciting. On Sunday, he didn't go out. He read a book and cooked dinner for his parents. 'Did you have a good weekend?' his boss Helen asked on Monday. 'Yes, I did. It was great!' said Sam.
passage.title: Sam's Weekend
passage.zh: Sam 周一到周五都很忙，所以周末对他很重要。上周六，他起得很晚，然后和朋友 Ben 去游泳了。之后，他们在月光咖啡馆吃了午饭。下午，Sam 弹了一个小时吉他。他去年加入了一个音乐俱乐部，现在在一个小乐队里演奏。晚上，他和同事们看了一部电影，特别精彩。周日他没出门，看了一本书，还给爸妈做了晚饭。周一，他的老板 Helen 问：「周末过得好吗？」「很好，太棒了！」Sam 说。

b.title: 阅读：Sam's Weekend（Sam 的周末）
听辨游戏：thin 还是 tin？（瘦的还是罐头）
单词第二遍：卡片自测（也可以选「听写」）

items: 我们周六看了一部电影。
We saw a film on Saturday.
Did you play the piano yesterday?
I didn't go out last night.
I am very interested in music.
c.title: 写 5 句话

speak.model: In my free time, I like listening to music and watching films. I am also interested in swimming. Last weekend, I went to the pool with my sister, and then we saw a film. It was really exciting. I think hobbies are important, because they help me relax.
speak.modelZh: 空闲的时候，我喜欢听音乐、看电影。我对游泳也很感兴趣。上周末我和姐姐去了游泳池，然后我们看了一部电影，特别精彩。我觉得爱好很重要，因为它们能让我放松。
phrases: In my free time, I like …
空闲时我喜欢……
I am also interested in …
我对……也很感兴趣
Last weekend, I went to … and then we saw …
上周末我去了……，然后我们看了……
speak.q: What do you like to do in your free time?
speak.tip: like 后面接动词时加 -ing：like listening、like swimming。最后加一个过去的例子（Last weekend, I went …），回答就有了细节。

c.title: 口语：你空闲时喜欢做什么？

days.title: 连读③，爱好，不规则动词和 did

a.title: 开场抽查：昨天的词句和本周难词（8 个）

lesson: 这一周学了：① 实词重读、虚词弱读（a、the、of、to、and、can、was……）；② 辅音 + 元音连读（How much is it?）；③ 辅音 + 辅音（bus stop、last night）；④ -ed 的三种读音（/t/、/d/、/ɪd/）；⑤ 元音 + 元音带出 /j/ 或 /w/（I agree、go out），还有 him、her、them 的弱读。做下面 8 道题，看看哪里还要补。
quiz: a ticket to London 里，to 通常读成？
How much is it? 连读后听起来像？
辅音 + 元音要连读：much is it → mu-chi-zit。
听到 /aɪ kən ˈswɪm/，can 读得很轻，意思是？
can 弱读，很轻；can't 的 /æ/ 响亮、重读。
last night 怎么读最自然？
last 的 t 读得很重
t 碰到下一个辅音，只做口型、不出声；但拼写时 t 不能丢。
walked = 走了；散了步（过去式）
do it 连读时，中间带出的过渡音是？
do 以 /uː/ 结尾，嘴唇是圆的，带出 /w/：do-wit。
听到 tel-ler the time，应该写成？
her 的 h 不发音，和 tell 连在一起：tel-ler。
a.title: 连读和弱读总复习

pairs: 打了电话（call 的过去式）
a.title: 听辨大挑战
150 个单词总复习

lesson: 这一周学了 there be、人称代词、物主代词和 this / that、一般过去时（was / were、规则动词 -ed、不规则动词和 did）。做一做下面 10 道题，看看哪里还要补。
quiz: There ___ a lot of traffic this morning.
traffic 不可数，当单数用。这里说的是已经过去的早上（比如晚上回想），所以用 was；如果说话时还是早上，就用 is：There is a lot of traffic this morning.（第 1 天写过）
buses 是复数，用 Are there。
午夜以后还有公交车吗？
I like these shoes. Can I try ___ on?
shoes 是复数，放在 try 后面，用宾格 them。
我喜欢这双鞋。我可以试穿吗？
Is this coffee ___? — Yes, it's mine.
后面没有名词，用单独用的 yours。
这杯咖啡是你的吗？——是，是我的。
My brother and ___ went to the gym yesterday.
做主语用 I：My brother and I went …
我哥哥和我昨天去了健身房。
last night 是过去，it 用 was。
We ___ tired after the long journey.
we 的过去式用 were；形容词 tired 前面要有 be。
长途旅行之后我们很累。
She ___ a headache yesterday, so she stayed at home.
have 的过去式是不规则的 had。
她昨天头疼，所以待在家里。
We ___ a film at home last night.
last night 是过去，规则动词加 -ed：watched。
我们昨晚在家看了一部电影。
Did you ___ a good weekend? — Yes, thanks!
你周末过得好吗？——很好，谢谢！

items: The number fourteen bus goes to the airport.
This dress is thirty-nine pounds ninety-nine.
这条连衣裙三十九英镑九十九便士。
My birthday is on the twentieth of February.
我的生日是二月二十日。
It was minus three degrees last night.
My name is Lucy Brown. That is B-R-O-W-N.
我叫 Lucy Brown，拼法是 B-R-O-W-N。
The appointment is on the ninth of May at a quarter to eleven.
预约在五月九日十点四十五分。
My phone number is oh seven eight double three.
We saw a film and had dinner together.
我们一起看了电影，吃了晚饭。
b.title: 听写综合：数字、日期和拼写（8 句）

parse: Tickets are five pounds for adults and two pounds fifty for children.
主干 Tickets are five pounds；for adults 说是谁的价钱；and 后面省略了 tickets are。
成人票五英镑，儿童票两英镑五十便士。
Last year, more than three thousand people came, and the weather was sunny and hot.
两个过去时的句子用 and 连起来：people came（came 是 come 的过去式）+ the weather was sunny and hot。
去年有三千多人来，天气晴朗炎热。
quiz: How many hours is the festival open each day?
from ten in the morning to eight in the evening：上午 10 点到晚上 8 点，一共 10 个小时。
美食节每天开放几个小时？
How much do two adults and a three-year-old child pay?
两个大人 2 × 5 = 10 英镑；三岁的孩子是 under five（五岁以下），免费，所以一共 10 英镑。
两个大人和一个三岁的孩子一共付多少钱？
Why should people come by bus or train?
Because there is no car park
原文：There is no car park, so please come by bus or train。
为什么大家应该坐公交或火车来？
passage.text: Come to the Maple Bridge Food Festival! It is on Saturday the twenty-first and Sunday the twenty-second of June, from ten in the morning to eight in the evening. There are more than fifty food stalls, with dishes from twenty countries. Tickets are five pounds for adults and two pounds fifty for children. Children under five are free. The festival is in Green Park, next to the train station. There is no car park, so please come by bus or train. The number fourteen bus stops at the park every fifteen minutes. Last year, more than three thousand people came, and the weather was sunny and hot. This year, bring a hat and some water!
passage.title: Maple Bridge Food Festival
passage.zh: 快来枫桥美食节吧！时间是 6 月 21 日（周六）和 22 日（周日），上午十点到晚上八点。现场有五十多个小吃摊，有来自二十个国家的美食。门票成人五英镑，儿童两英镑五十便士，五岁以下儿童免费。美食节在绿色公园，就在火车站旁边。那里没有停车场，所以请坐公交或火车来。14 路公交车每十五分钟在公园停一次。去年有三千多人来，天气晴朗炎热。今年请带上帽子和水！

b.title: 阅读：Maple Bridge Food Festival（枫桥美食节）

c.title: 写 6 句话：上周写错的句子，再写一遍

speak.model: Last weekend was great. On Saturday morning, I went to the market and bought some fruit. The weather was sunny, so I walked home. In the afternoon, I studied English for two hours. On Sunday, I had dinner with my family at a restaurant. The food was delicious.
speak.modelZh: 上周末过得很棒。周六上午我去了市场，买了一些水果。天气晴朗，所以我走路回家。下午我学了两个小时英语。周日我和家人在一家餐馆吃了晚饭，菜很好吃。
phrases: Last weekend was great.
上周末过得很棒。
On Saturday morning, I went to … and bought …
周六上午我去了……，买了……
The weather was …, so I …
天气……，所以我……
speak.q: What did you do last weekend?
speak.tip: 整段都用过去式：went、bought、walked、studied、had、was。录完听一遍，检查 -ed 有没有读出来。
